HexKagune 1.0.39 for Forge 1.20.1 (clients need PlayerAnimator, bendy-lib and Photon). Install on client and server (protocol 49). Testing build.

- **Centipede Dominion steering:** your aim now goes to the server every tick; before, the centipede steered by the way you faced when you cast it, so W/A/D and looking up ignored the camera.
- **Centipede Dominion range:** your hidden body follows the head, so far-off land, mobs and other players stay loaded and visible instead of the centipede gliding flat through hills.
- **Centipede Dominion camera:** the chase camera follows the neck, so it no longer lurches with every bite and slam, and it stops spinning when you look straight down.
